facts.fact: ANINF, Gabon's national digital agency, says on its own site that it designs digital tools itself: the electronic driving licence, the Marigest merchant-navy application and the KEWA platform.
ANINF says it works on the Gabonese Administration Network (RAG) and builds digital tools for administrations and citizens.
ANINF says it designed the electronic driving licence; no contractor is named.
ANINF says it designed the Marigest application for the merchant navy; no contractor is named.
ANINF says it designed the KEWA platform; no contractor is named.
